summary: Pinned Assetrizz sci-fi/fantasy world tiles and enemy strips, six original Gloamforge weapon views and card previews, and a cropped-stone Cinder theme variant.
useWhen: Select theme/assetrizz, theme/assetrizz-fantasy or theme/assetrizz-cinder for a shooter presentation using the standard theme keys.
limitations: Shooter-oriented texture/visual vocabulary. Assetrizz art provenance is original, generated for Kyle Durepos; weapon renders and synthesized sound have separate original provenance.
